variant_note.en: West Bank paper of the 2025 complementary (third) session. The original file name is "الرياضيات - علمي - الثالثة-الضفة.pdf" (الضفة = West Bank). It is one combined paper (header: الورقة: --, الدورة الاستكمالية) covering the whole examined syllabus, not a workbook. No Gaza counterpart is hosted.

notes: Matrices and determinants in "latex" follow the paper's right-to-left (Arabic) reading: the right-most printed column is column 1 and rows read from right to left, so a matrix printed left to right as [3, -2 / -5, x] is transcribed [[-2,3],[x,-5]]. This reading is confirmed wherever an answer depends on it: 2025 s2-p2 Q2-a-1 gives the listed x=4 only under it (left to right gives x=8/3, not an option); likewise s2-p2 Q3-a-1 (-4) and s3 Q4-a-1 (A^-1). Anyone re-checking a transcription against the scan must mirror each row.

Part (a) MCQ items carry no printed per-item marks; each is inferred as part-marks / 3. Numbered sub-parts of (b)/(c) carry no printed marks; they are inferred as an equal split of the printed part marks (marks_basis says so).
A lone dot used as an integral limit is the Arabic-Indic digit zero (٠).
No item tests unit 6 (complex numbers) in any 2025 paper.
Item MCQ labels in this paper use "اختر الإجابة الصحيحة واكتبها في المكان المخصص" instead of the s1/s2 wording; MCQ items worth 4 marks each (inferred).
